title: Power BI Report Server Weekly Active User Trend
dataSources: Power BI Report Server execution log (`powerbi:reportserver`).
app: Power BI Report Server ExecutionLog via DB Connect and service logs via UF.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=powerbi:reportserver
| timechart span=1w dc(user) as active_users
| eventstats avg(active_users) as avg_users
| eval below_trend=if(active_users<avg_users*0.85,1,0)
description: Trends the number of distinct weekly active users of Power BI Report Server and flags weeks where engagement drops below trend, an early signal of eroding adoption or an access problem.
value: Adoption is the return on a BI investment; a declining active-user trend for Power BI Report Server surfaces churn before a renewal or rationalisation review.
implementation: Ingest Power BI Report Server usage/activity events; schedule weekly and review adoption dips with the platform owner.
visualization: Timechart of Power BI Report Server weekly active users with trend band.
grandmaExplanation: We track how many people actually use Power BI Report Server each week so a drop in usage is noticed early.
